```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bats jq curl

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t dkron-e2e .

      - name: Start test cluster
        run: |
          make e2e-start

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: |
          make e2e
        timeout-minutes: 15

      - name: Collect container logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker logs dkron-server-1 > server1.log || true
          docker logs dkron-server-2 > server2.log || true
          docker logs dkron-server-3 > server3.log || true
          cat server1.log server2.log server3.log

      - name: Cleanup resources
        if: always()
        run: |
          make e2e-stop || true
          docker rmi dkron-e2e || true
```
